verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortwave's own built-in AI Assistant reading threads and writing drafts, and that assistant acting as an MCP client that connects out to other apps. Neither gives an external agent (Claude, ChatGPT, or your own) a documented inbound connection to read, triage, draft and send your email. The Tasklet item is a single partner integration that only mentions drafts, not a general documented connection. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
